## What is the technology profile {#what-is-the-technology-profile}

What an Engine works on, in two vocabularies: **OpenAlex topics** for papers and **CPC groups** for patents.
It is built from the NSF grant text only. A paper is *in the Engine's topics* when one of its topics is in the
profile; a patent is *in the profile* when one of its CPC codes is. All metrics on this site still use version 1.

### Embeddings in detail (version 3.1) {#embeddings-in-detail}

Version 3.1 ranks every OpenAlex topic and every CPC group by how close it is in meaning to each technology of
the grant. Nobody chooses here: the items are only sorted by distance, the same way for all 43 technologies.

1. **One text per technology.** The technology's label and its phrases of the grant are joined into one text,
   for example *"Continuous processing and data-driven process control. continuous flow processing; data-driven
   process control"*. 43 texts in total. The Engine's name and the word "Engine" are removed (the patent model
   reads "engine" as a motor).
2. **Two models, two separate comparisons.** A model turns every text into a point in a space of meaning;
   texts about similar things lie close together.

   ::: {.no-sort}

   | | The 43 technologies are compared with | Model |
   |---|---|---|
   | Papers | 4,516 OpenAlex topics: name, description, keywords | SPECTER2, trained on research papers |
   | Patents | 7,646 CPC main groups: titles of the subclass, the group and its subgroups | PatentSBERTa, trained on patents |

   :::

3. **Closeness.** All scientific texts are somewhat alike, so the average point of each set is subtracted first;
   what is left are the real differences in meaning. Closeness is the cosine between the technology's point and
   the item's point: 1 means the same meaning, 0 unrelated.
4. **Top 20.** For each technology, all 4,516 topics and all 7,646 CPC groups are sorted by closeness; the 20
   closest of each are the candidates. Choosing among them is the next step (not settled yet).

Because the text holds all the phrases of a technology, a group close to all of them scores high by itself
(illustrative numbers):

::: {.no-sort}

| CPC group | Closeness to the technology |
|---|---|
| B01J19 Chemical, physical or physico-chemical processes in general; their apparatus | 0.24 |
| G05B13 Adaptive control systems | 0.21 |
| B01J8 Processes conducted in the presence of fluids and solid particles; apparatus | 0.17 |

:::

## Technologies of each grant {#grant-technologies}

```{r tech-setup, include=FALSE}
techs <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_minplus_technologies.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
n_tech <- techs |> distinct(engine_name, tech_id) |> nrow()
per_engine <- techs |> distinct(engine_name, tech_id) |> count(engine_name)
sentences <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_v2_sentences.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(engine_name, sent_id, sentence = text_original)
# The full sentence of the abstract (or the title) each phrase comes from, with the technology's phrases in bold
in_context <- function(d) {
  d <- d |> left_join(sentences, by = c("engine_name", "sent_id"))
  ids <- sort(unique(d$sent_id))
  paste(vapply(ids, function(i) {
    x <- esc(d$sentence[d$sent_id == i][1])
    for (f in unique(d$fragment[d$sent_id == i])) x <- sub(esc(f), paste0("<b>", esc(f), "</b>"), x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
  }, ""), collapse = "<br><br>")
}
```

**`r n_tech` technologies, `r min(per_engine$n)`–`r max(per_engine$n)` per Engine** — the common first step for
versions 1 and 3.1. A short fixed prompt asks the model to copy out, word for word, the phrases of the grant
that name a technology and to group them into the grant's technologies. It was run three times; a phrase is
kept when at least two runs found it (`r nrow(techs)` phrases), and the grouping is that of the run that agrees
most with the other two. The labels are the model's own short names; the phrases are the grant's words.

```{r tech-tables, results = "asis"}
tech_engines <- sort(unique(techs$engine_name))
cat('<select id="tech-engine" class="form-control" style="width:auto; margin-bottom:10px" aria-label="Engine">\n',
    paste0('<option value="', seq_along(tech_engines), '">', esc(tech_engines), "</option>", collapse = "\n"),
    "\n</select>\n\n")
for (k in seq_along(tech_engines)) {
  t <- techs |> filter(engine_name == tech_engines[k]) |>
    group_by(tech_id, tech_label) |>
    summarise(phrases = paste0("<i>", esc(fragment), "</i> <span style='color:#888'>(", n_runs, "/3)</span>",
                               collapse = "<br>"),
              context = in_context(pick(everything()) |> mutate(engine_name = tech_engines[k])),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(tech_id)
  tab <- tibble(`#` = t$tech_id, Technology = esc(t$tech_label),
                `Phrases of the grant (verbatim; runs that found it)` = t$phrases,
                `In the abstract (phrases in bold)` = paste0("<span style='font-size:90%'>", t$context, "</span>"))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="tech-engine" data-k="%d"%s>\n', k, if (k > 1) ' style="display:none"' else ""))
  print(kable(tab, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"'))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```

<script>
// Dropdown: show the chosen Engine's technologies
document.getElementById("tech-engine").addEventListener("change", function () {
  var k = this.value;
  document.querySelectorAll(".tech-engine").forEach(function (d) {
    d.style.display = d.getAttribute("data-k") === k ? "" : "none";
  });
});
</script>

## [drop] Profile of each Engine {#technology-profile}

Choose an Engine and a version. **Metrics still use v1.** In v3.1, <sup>J</sup> marks an item chosen by the
judge rather than confirmed by the two signals; "—" marks a place the procedure could not fill.

```{r profile-tables, results = "asis"}
engines <- sort(unique(profile$engine_name))
cat('<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:10px">',
    '<select id="profile-engine" class="form-control" style="width:auto" aria-label="Engine">\n',
    paste0('<option value="', seq_along(engines), '">', esc(engines), "</option>", collapse = "\n"),
    '\n</select>',
    '<select id="profile-version" class="form-control" style="width:auto" aria-label="Profile version">',
    '<option value="v1">v1 (used by the metrics)</option><option value="v31">v3.1 (core)</option></select>',
    "</div>\n\n")
# "C22B; C22C" + "C22B:688; C22C:2757" + "C22B:10; C22C:61" -> "C22B (688 / 10)<br>C22C (2757 / 61)"
fmt_cpc <- function(cpc, us, reg) {
  if (is.na(cpc)) return("")
  codes <- str_split_1(cpc, ";\\s*")
  counts <- function(x) { v <- str_split_1(coalesce(x, ""), ";\\s*")
                          setNames(str_extract(v, "\\d+$"), str_remove(v, ":.*$")) }
  n_us <- counts(us); n_reg <- counts(reg)
  paste(sprintf("%s (%s / %s)", codes, coalesce(n_us[codes], "?"), coalesce(n_reg[codes], "?")), collapse = "<br>")
}
for (k in seq_along(engines)) {
  p <- profile |> filter(engine_name == engines[k]) |> arrange(item)
  tab <- tibble(`#` = p$item,
                Source = p$source,
                Statement = esc(p$statement),
                `Quote from the grant` = paste0("<i>", esc(str_trunc(coalesce(p$quote, ""), 220)), "</i>"),
                `OpenAlex topic (subfield)` = paste0(esc(p$topic), "<br><span style='color:#666'>",
                                                     esc(p$subfield), "</span>"),
                `CPC (US / region patents, 2024-25)` = mapply(fmt_cpc, p$cpc, p$cpc_patents_us_2024_25,
                                                              p$cpc_patents_region_2024_25))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="profile-engine" data-k="%d" data-v="v1"%s>\n', k, if (k > 1) ' style="display:none"' else ""))
  print(kable(tab, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"'))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}

# Version 3.1: one row per technology; items of the core, judge-chosen ones marked J, empty places as a dash
item_html <- function(d, kind) {
  d <- d[d$kind == kind & d$in_core, ]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return("&mdash;")
  lab <- if (kind == "oa") paste0(esc(d$item_title), "<br><span style='color:#666'>", esc(d$subclass_or_subfield), "</span>")
         else paste0("<b>", esc(d$item_id), "</b> ", esc(str_trunc(d$item_title, 90)))
  paste0(lab, ifelse(startsWith(d$basis, "judge"), "<sup>J</sup>", ""), collapse = "<br>")
}
for (k in seq_along(engines)) {
  c3 <- core31 |> filter(engine_name == engines[k])
  techs <- c3 |> distinct(tech_id, tech_label) |> arrange(tech_id)
  tab <- tibble(`#` = techs$tech_id,
                Technology = esc(techs$tech_label),
                `OpenAlex topics (subfield)` = sapply(techs$tech_id, \(t) item_html(c3[c3$tech_id == t, ], "oa")),
                `CPC groups` = sapply(techs$tech_id, \(t) item_html(c3[c3$tech_id == t, ], "cpc")))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="profile-engine" data-k="%d" data-v="v31" style="display:none">\n', k))
  print(kable(tab, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"'))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```

<script>
// Dropdowns: show the chosen Engine's profile table in the chosen version
function showProfile() {
  var k = document.getElementById("profile-engine").value;
  var v = document.getElementById("profile-version").value;
  document.querySelectorAll(".profile-engine").forEach(function (d) {
    d.style.display = d.getAttribute("data-k") === k && d.getAttribute("data-v") === v ? "" : "none";
  });
}
document.getElementById("profile-engine").addEventListener("change", showProfile);
document.getElementById("profile-version").addEventListener("change", showProfile);
</script>

## Classification lists {#classification-lists}

Both lists are public; copies are kept in the repository (`data/reference/`). Each has two levels: **coarse
categories** and the **codes** inside them.

::: {.no-sort}

| | Coarse categories | Codes inside them | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAlex | 250 subfields | 4,516 topics, with keywords | [OpenAlex topics API](https://api.openalex.org/topics) |
| CPC | 652 subclasses | 7,646 main groups | [CPC Title List 2026.08](https://www.cooperativepatentclassification.org/cpcSchemeAndDefinitions/bulk) |

:::

CPC indexing groups (2000+) and catch-all groups (99/00) are left out. Both lists downloaded on
November 15, 2026.
